summary_1line: Janamejaya asks about the Pandavas’ forest exile as they depart Hastinapura after the dice defeat, followed by grieving citizens praising their virtue.

image_candidates.scene_text: The Pandavas, armed and solemn, walk out of Hastinapura’s Vardhamana gate with Draupadi as grieving citizens follow behind.
Crowds of citizens with folded hands plead with the departing Pandavas not to abandon them as they stand on the road outside the city.
